script: Ceres is the largest object in the asteroid belt. It is a dwarf planet, about 940 kilometers wide. It holds about a third of the belt's total mass. NASA's Dawn spacecraft found bright, salty spots in one of its craters. Ceres may have salty water deep beneath its surface. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
